Hi! I'm Sean Bosch, a graduate student in the MS in AI and Business Analytics program at Baruch College's Zicklin School of Business, concentrating in data analytics.

Before Baruch, I earned a BA in History from the College of Staten Island (CUNY). I'm interested in bringing data analytics to cultural institutions, museums, and New York City agencies, where history and data meet.

This site hosts my work for STA 9750: Software Tools for Data Analysis.
